{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep only the row with the highest sample_seq per patient_id
deduplicated_data = data.loc[data.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Count unique patients
num_patients = len(deduplicated_data)

print(num_patients)"}
